dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The lateral mid-section features several distinct 'O' and 'C' shaped annuli with irregular, crenulated high-intensity perimeters. There is a sharp gradient transition from the dark exterior background to the bright outer ring, which surrounds a darker internal core.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High-intensity, asymmetrical pixel clusters lacking internal gradients are concentrated primarily along the lower ventral-lateral margin. These blobs exhibit high spatial density, forming localized clusters and irregular chains in the posterior-ventral region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent 'O' shaped macro-annuli in the mid-lateral region form an obtuse triangle. A secondary linear relationship is formed by four high-intensity blobs located anteriorly to this triangle, oriented roughly parallel to the dorsal line.
